Name: Noopy - Off Site, Mutts with Manners
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Looking for a dog who's handsome, enthusiastic, and fun as heck? Meet Noopy, your future best friend! Noopy is a little over two years old and weighs about 60 pounds—right at the top end of medium-sized, with the heart of a lap dog. (And yes, he will try to sit on your lap!) This pibble mix is full of personality and charm, with a striking coat and bright, expressive eyes that sparkle with curiosity and excitement. He’s always up for an adventure—walks, hikes, backyard zoomies, or anything involving toys and attention. He pulls on the leash a bit, but it’s just because he’s so excited to be out and about. With a bit of guidance and consistency, Giles is well on his way to being the best boy. Noopy already has the good boy genes—he just needs a little help turning them into good boy manners. And he's gonna learn all that at Mutts with Manners! Apply here: https://www.dbchs.org/muttswithmannersdogs

Name: Roni - Adoption Fee Sponsored
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Roni is a handsome 2-year-old hound mix with a happy spirit and a personality that wins people over everywhere he goes. He loves attention and is always ready to greet new friends with that bright smile of his. Roni has already proven himself to be quite the social guy. He’s done wonderfully meeting kids during school field trips, enjoys Doggie Day Out adventures, and even handles busy coffee shops like a pro. Whether he’s out exploring or simply soaking up attention from everyone around him, Roni takes it all in stride. Inside his kennel, Roni may try to impress you with his world-class parkour skills — he just gets a little excited showing off! Once he’s out and spending time with people, his easygoing and charming personality really shines.
Dog_Attributes: Affectionate, Cuddly, Friendly, Housebroken, Meet and greet required, Playful, Shy

Name: Nico
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Nico is a big, handsome boy with a personality that truly shines once he gets to know you. Behind that strong presence is a sweet, loyal dog who forms deep, unbreakable bonds with his people and loves nothing more than being close to those he trusts. Nico has been through a lot, but his resilient spirit still shines through. Once he feels safe and comfortable, his playful, silly side comes out—complete with one of the goofiest smiles you’ll ever see. He soaks up attention, adores spending time with his humans, and shows off an affectionate side that makes it impossible not to fall in love with him. Because Nico values his safe space and personal connections so deeply, he needs to be the only dog in the household. While he can coexist around other dogs, any future introductions must be done very cautiously and at a slow pace. Nico is the definition of a heart dog—the kind who builds a true, lifelong connection with his person. For a patient adopter willing to give him a peaceful, single-pet home and the time he needs to settle in, Nico will reward that kindness with endless loyalty, devotion, and a whole lot of character.
Dog_Attributes: Active, Affectionate, Friendly, Meet and greet required, Playful, Scared of men, Good with Kids, Single Dog Home

Name: Sully - Adoption Fee Sponsored
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Sully is a handsome 3-year-old with a smile so big it’s impossible not to smile back! A long-term resident since August 2025, Sully is a true "people person" when it comes to adults. The moment he sees a friendly face, that famous grin appears, and his whole body lights up with excitement. This playful boy still has plenty of youthful energy and loves being part of the fun, whether he’s greeting you with happy wiggles or leaning in for some well-earned pets. Ideal Home: Adult-Oriented: Sully is looking for a mature household with children aged 13 and older. Younger children can be overwhelming for him, and he prefers a calm, predictable environment where he feels secure. Dog Selectivity: Sully is selective about his canine friends. In playgroups, he typically prefers smaller female dogs. If you have another dog at home, a meet-and-greet is required to ensure they are a good match. If you’re looking for a fun-loving, loyal companion with a heart of gold and a smile that can brighten your whole day, Sully is ready to meet you!
Dog_Attributes: Kids 13+, Active, Adult-Only Home Preferred, Affectionate, Friendly, Gentle, Meet and greet required, Playful

Name: Axel - Adoption Fee Sponsored
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Axel Personality: Healthy, happy, fiercely loyal, and super smart! Skills: Knows sit, down, shake, beg, roll over, and walks great with a routine. Favorite Things: Playgroups (bounces like a bunny!), showing off tricks for treats, and lounging in the office. Needs: A family who appreciates a brainy dog and can offer a predictable routine. Bonus: Fully vetted, neutered, and sponsored by Billy's BBQ—he’s ready to head home today!

Name: Rebel
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Hi, I’m Rebel! I’m a young, energetic guy who loves to play, stay busy, and be part of the action. At about 50 pounds, I’m a great medium size — easy to handle, perfect for adventures, and just right for everyday life. I’ve also got the cutest little nub of a tail and a sweet face that’s guaranteed to melt your heart! I’m treat-motivated and eager to learn, which makes training fun and rewarding. I would thrive in an active home that enjoys walks, playtime, and continuing my training so I can be the best boy I can be. I love my toys and sometimes guard them because they’re very special to me. I’ll do best with a family who understands this behavior and is willing to help me work on sharing and trading games to build my confidence and good habits. If you’re looking for a fun, smart, and affectionate companion with a big personality in a perfectly sized package, I might be your guy!
Dog_Attributes: Playful, Quirky, Friendly, Active, Affectionate, Kids 13+

Name: Onix off-site at Mutts with Manners
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Hi! I’m Onix, and enthusiasm is kind of my thing! I’m a playful young girl with endless puppy energy and a joyful spirit. I get very excited during playtime and am still learning to slow down, but I’m eager to learn and ready for adventure. Speaking of learning, I'm at Mutts with Manners to hone my skills!

Name: Oreo - off-site at Mutts with Manners
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Hi, I’m Mustard! I’m a sleek black-and-white Terrier / American Pit Bull mix with lots of playful, puppy energy still left in me. I may look calm and relaxed in my kennel, but once I’m outside and with my people, my fun-loving personality really comes to life! I love to play and can get a little mouthy when I get excited, so I’ll do best with a family who’s ready to help me keep working on my manners. The good news? I’m very food-motivated, which makes training fun, rewarding, and a great way for us to bond. If you’re looking for a happy, energetic girl who’s ready for playtime, learning, and lots of love, I might be the perfect match for you!

Name: Elias
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Hi, I’m Elias! I’m a 4-year-old medium mixed-breed with a gorgeous coat—black and brown with a white, speckled chest. I’m very friendly and sweet and love people. I’m still working on my manners and can get excited and jump up, so I may need some guidance around smaller children. With time, patience, and consistency, I’ll do great and continue to improve.

Name: Socks
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Meet Socks! This tall, beautiful 1.5-year-old girl is an absolute gem who is rapidly coming out of her shell and showing off her amazing personality. While she can start off a tad timid, her sweet, playful nature shines through the moment she gets outside! Why You’ll Love Her: Yard Enthusiast: Running around in the yard and getting a few tasty treats are the fast tracks to Socks’ heart. Great with Kids: Socks is gentle and does wonderfully with children! A True "Dog’s Dog": Socks loves canine companions. She would thrive most in a home with a settled, confident resident dog to show her the ropes and be her built-in best friend. Ideal Home: Socks is looking for a family with a yard to zoom in, some kiddos to love, and a doggy sibling to guide her as she continues to blossom. If you have a friendly dog at home looking for a playful sister, Socks is your girl!
Dog_Attributes: No Cats, No chickens, Not Good with Cats, Good with Kids, Friendly

Name: Otto off-site at Mutts with Manners
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: If you’re looking for energy… I’ve got plenty to share! I’m a one-year-old bundle of go, go, go, and I’m always ready for the next adventure. Sitting still? Not really my thing—I’d much rather be playing, running, or finding something fun to do with you. I haven’t quite mastered “calm” yet, but I make up for it with my excitement for life and my love for people. I’m looking for a friend who can keep up with me, enjoy some rough-and-tumble play, and help me burn off all this energy in the best ways. If you’re ready for an adventure buddy who will keep life exciting, I’m your guy!

Name: Stone
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Stone is a gorgeous 2-year-old brindle boy (55 lbs) who is a certified cuddle champion and an absolute superstar with people! Having spent time living in a real home environment, Stone comes with glowing reviews from his previous family. He is a total "center of attention" guy who thrives on being involved in whatever his humans are doing. His absolute favorite activity in the world? Joining in on big family cuddle piles and taking cozy naps with kids! He bonded instantly with the children in his previous home and has proven to be an amazingly affectionate, easygoing family companion. Stone is super social and loves making dog friends, too! Because he’s already experienced living in a house, he has a great head start on home manners and routines. The Details: Kids & Adults: Loves them! A total cuddle bug who wants to be the star of the show. Dogs: Dog-friendly and loves having canine buddies! Cats/Small Animals: Strictly no cats or small animals for Stone, as he has a strong prey drive.

Name: Riot
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Riot is a gorgeous red-brown beauty with a big heart, a lot of passion, and an even bigger voice! If you meet Riot inside her kennel, she might give you a loud first impression. Shelters are stressful, and Riot uses her big, powerful barks and growls to vent her frustration and express her uncertain feelings about being behind bars. But her kennel reaction isn't the whole story—it's just a cover for a dog who is desperately ready to go home! Step outside the kennel with her, and Riot transforms into a fun-loving, joyful playmate! She is a ball-fetching superstar—toss a ball, and she is on it. She’s still working on the "drop it" phase of fetch, so bringing a second ball for a swap (or bringing your top-notch negotiation skills!) is highly recommended. Riot is deeply treat-motivated, eager to learn, and ready to swap shelter life for a yard of her own. She just needs a dog-savvy adopter who can look past her loud front door and see the fun, play-loving girl underneath.

Name: Oak
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Meet Oak! Don't let my kennel manners fool you- once I'm outside I am an active explorer! I love to investigate EVERYTHING, follow my nose and take the world at a fun and fast pace. My superpowers? - Mega Ears: Perfect for listening for treat bags being opened. - Super Sniffer: My nose can track down even the most expertly hidden treats.

Name: Sienna
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: About Me: Retired Mama & Spayed: Ready to be the center of your attention! Ultimate Love Bug: Snuggles are the absolute fastest way to my heart. Sweet Hugger: I love pressing my face against yours for tender, sweet embraces. Adorably Unique: Look for my cute little tongue sticking out! Ideal Home: A loving family who wants a devoted, affectionate companion within arm's reach for endless cuddles.

Name: Miney
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: If you're looking for an instant best friend, look no further than Miney! ** I scream for excitement, come say hi!** At 6 years old and a perfect 50 pounds, Miney is in the absolute prime of her life. She is the definition of a "good girl"—past the chaotic puppy phase, delightfully well-mannered, and overflowing with affection. Miney has two simple passions in life: delicious treats and good old-fashioned booty scratches! Give her a rump scratch, and you’ll have a loyal friend for life. Miney is the ultimate plug-and-play companion, ready to jump right into your daily routine—whether that means going on casual walks, practicing tricks for snacks, or lounging by your side. Miney is waiting to meet you—come give her a treat and a scratch today!
